text.en: Reviewers express immense gratitude for owner Taryn and sitters Cate, Sabrina, and Susie, highlighting their dependable and caring nature. Pet parents appreciate that the team handles last-minute bookings seamlessly, maintains contingency coverage, and treats client homes with utmost respect.

Clients praise the sitters' gentle care for senior cats and pets requiring medication or special diets. Multiple reviewers share that sitters readily handle unexpected health issues, clean up thoroughly, and spend quality time comforting cats so owners return home to calm, happy companions.

Pet owners consistently mention feeling total peace of mind thanks to frequent, thorough communication. Reviewers note that sitters send daily text reports accompanied by cheerful photos and videos, keeping travelers fully informed about their pets' eating habits, mood, and daily activities.

q.en: Can sitters administer oral medication to cats?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that sitters comfortably administer prescribed medications and monitor health routines.

q.en: Does the service offer overnight cat sitting?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention booking overnight sitting arrangements for cats needing companionship while owners travel.

q.en: How do sitters keep owners informed during bookings?

a.en: Owners report receiving daily written status updates along with photos and videos after each scheduled visit.
